title: Sybaris Prime
extract:
The Sybaris Prime is the Prime variant of the  Sybaris burst-fire rifle, with improvements to damage, critical chance, status chance, and magazine size, with some expense to accuracy. It was released alongside  Oberon Prime and  Silva & Aegis Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage by a small margin.
Advantages over other Primary Burst Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High crit chance (30.00%)
High burst DPS (380.95)
Very high sustained DPS (706.17)
High damage per shot (228.8)
Very high total damage (88)
Very high ammo pickup (80)
High ammo max (540)
Incarnon Form (wiki attack index 2)
Above average crit chance (25.00%)
Very high burst DPS (549.45)
Very high sustained DPS (576.92)
Above average magazine size (20)

Very high total damage (110)
Very high status chance (30.00%)
Very high crit multiplier (3.00x)

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)

Acquisition

Notes

Incarnon Genesis
Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Sybaris Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Sybaris with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
